title: Do Search-Augmented Recommenders Use the Latest Search Episode?
abstract: arXiv:2611.06044v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Search-augmented recommenders can use the latest search episode and earlier searches. We introduce FocalSwap to test how these inputs contribute to the next recommendation. For each recommendation, it changes the latest search slot or all search inputs while holding the target, candidates, pre-search history, and scorer fixed. It compares neutral masks with matched observed-search replacements, recording rank changes, RR gains relative to each control, and preference for the true focal search. A planted signal and GenSAR's current-query task confirm that the audit detects known input dependence. We evaluate behavioral and lexical evidence on KuaiSAR and Qilin, and recommendation checkpoints trained using the released SESRec and UniSAR implementations.   Across three independently trained UniSAR checkpoints, the estimated all-source benefit depends on the control. On the same 66,139 rows, replacing all search inputs with a neutral ID yi

translated_title: 搜索增强推荐系统是否使用了最新的搜索会话？
translated_abstract: 搜索增强推荐系统可以利用最新的搜索会话以及更早的搜索记录。我们提出FocalSwap来测试这些输入对下一次推荐的贡献。对于每一条推荐，FocalSwap在保持目标、候选集、搜索前历史和评分器不变的情况下，替换最新的搜索槽位或所有搜索输入。它将中性掩码与匹配的已观测搜索替换进行对比，记录排名变化、相对于各对照组的RR增益，以及对真实焦点搜索的偏好。植入信号实验和GenSAR的当前查询任务证实，该审计方法能够检测到已知的输入依赖。我们在KuaiSAR和Qilin数据集上评估行为与词汇证据，并使用基于公开的SESRec和UniSAR实现所训练的推荐模型检查点进行实验。在三个独立训练的UniSAR检查点上，估计的全源收益取决于对照组的选择。在相同的66,139行数据上，将所有搜索输入替换为中性ID…（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出FocalSwap审计框架，通过在固定目标与候选集的条件下替换最新搜索或全部搜索输入，检验搜索增强推荐系统对最新搜索会话的实际依赖程度，发现其估计收益随对照方式的选择而变化。
en_tdlr: Proposes FocalSwap, an audit framework that tests how much search-augmented recommenders rely on the latest search episode by swapping search inputs while holding targets and candidates fixed, finding that estimated benefits depend on the choice of control.
